name: How many people are typically in a small-group training session at Cave Training?
description: Small-group training sessions at Cave Training usually have 2 to 6 participants, allowing for significant individual attention from coaches.

mainEntity.name: How many people are typically in a small-group training session at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: At Cave Training, small-group training sessions typically consist of 2 to 6 participants. This size allows our functional-fitness coaches to provide significant individual attention, ensuring proper form, technique correction, and personalized modifications for each person. The smaller number fosters a close-knit environment, enhancing teamwork and mutual encouragement.
